info.title: GitHub Webhook Events API
info.description: Test fixture for header sub-case B two-level dispatch. Event type is delivered via X-GitHub-Event header; action is delivered as payload.action. Compound events (pull_request, issues) have name != x-ballerina-event-type. Simple events (push, create) have name == x-ballerina-event-type.

production.description: Webhook endpoint where GitHub delivers events.

webhook_url.description: The HTTPS URL of your server where GitHub sends webhook payloads.

pull_request.description: Pull request lifecycle events. X-GitHub-Event header value is 'pull_request'; action discriminates the specific event.

issues.description: Issue lifecycle events. X-GitHub-Event header value is 'issues'; action discriminates the specific event.

repository.description: Repository push and ref creation events. Each message is a simple event: name == x-ballerina-event-type, no action field in payload.

oneOf.name: push
oneOf.summary: One or more commits were pushed to a repository branch or tag.

oneOf.name: create
oneOf.summary: A Git branch or tag was created.

PullRequestPayload.description: Payload for pull_request events. The action field discriminates opened vs closed.

IssuePayload.description: Payload for issues events. The action field discriminates opened vs closed.

PushPayload.description: Payload for push events. No action field — this is a simple event.

ref.description: The full Git ref that was pushed.

before.description: The SHA of the most recent commit on the ref before the push.

after.description: The SHA of the most recent commit on the ref after the push.

CreatePayload.description: Payload for create events. No action field — this is a simple event.

ref.description: The Git ref that was created.

ref_type.description: The type of Git ref object created: branch or tag.
